all_coordinate_responses.scope: All 31 frozen primary512 coordinates, equal fixed-template weights; descriptive point estimates only, without additional hypothesis tests.

claim_scope: The primary estimands are finite-template, two-instruction service response interactions in median image chroma. A negative named-minus-generic interaction supports attenuation only with positive free/generic responses and without a named response reversal. Two levels do not distinguish reduced gain from a shifted operating range or saturation. No human validation, internal model mechanism, perceptual fidelity, or explanation of the original/generated gap is established by these estimates.

transport_summary.scope: All completed attempts with retained metadata, including failures and retries; latency summaries exclude attempts without an observed transport duration.

assumptions: Conditional on the six fixed templates and their equal weights; no new-scene inference.
Independent replicate blocks with stable within-template distributions; block-common additive disturbances cancel in the response interactions.
Welch–Satterthwaite t inference is approximate, including under non-Gaussian noise; randomized dispatch does not make a weak zero-interaction test exact.
The two primary intervals use Bonferroni allocation of the family alpha. Holm-adjusted two-sided p-values are reported separately.
Any unavailable planned measurement withholds primary inference. Complete-block survivor summaries cannot identify the originally allocated response effect.

reference_context.quantile_definition: Generalized inverse of normalized weighted empirical CDF; central80 means inclusive empirical 10th–90th percentiles.
reference_context.scope: Post-result exposed digital references, not an independent holdout or human-validated style target. Broad classes were assigned by a single maintainer-run LLM; class weighting does not establish fine-content, period or capture matching. Empirical chroma overlap and Wasserstein distance concern one coordinate, not overall style or equivalence. The equal-polarity mixture is a designed experimental mixture, not a model's unprompted output distribution.
reference_context.uncertainty: No confidence intervals, tests, target validation or equivalence threshold is assigned to these exposed-reference descriptions.
